Dynatec Madagascar SA Names New Managing Director to Lead Expansion Efforts

Dynatec Madagascar SA, a key player in Madagascar’s metals and mining sector, has announced the appointment of Jean-Claude Rakotomalala as its new Managing Director, effective immediately. The move comes as the company seeks to strengthen its operational capabilities and reinforce its commitment to sustainable mining practices in the region.

Rakotomalala brings over 25 years of industry experience, having previously held senior roles at several regional mining companies, most recently at Ambatovy Resources Ltd. His appointment is widely viewed as a strategic decision aimed at enhancing Dynatec Madagascar SA’s local engagement and expanding its project portfolio.

“We are delighted to welcome Jean-Claude Rakotomalala to the leadership team,” said Marie Randrianarisoa, Chair of the Board. “His deep knowledge of Madagascar’s mining landscape and proven leadership will be invaluable as we continue to grow responsibly and deliver value to all stakeholders.”

Industry analysts note that Dynatec Madagascar SA has maintained steady production volumes despite fluctuating global commodity prices. “The company has shown resilience and adaptability, and this new appointment signals a clear intent to further professionalize operations and foster innovation,” commented Patrice Andriamanana, a mining sector analyst at Antananarivo-based consultancy Manjakamiadana Advisory.

Rakotomalala emphasized his commitment to collaboration with local communities and regulatory bodies. “Sustainable development is at the heart of Dynatec Madagascar SA’s strategy,” he stated. “I look forward to working with our talented team to ensure our operations contribute positively to the Malagasy economy and environment.”

With this leadership transition, Dynatec Madagascar SA is expected to continue its focus on operational excellence and community investment, reinforcing its position as one of the island nation’s leading mining operators. No significant changes to project timelines or output targets have been announced as a result of the appointment.
